lede: Requirements? Just show up. DIMFF 2027 opens its doors to students and filmmakers anywhere with five mobile-first categories.
body:
"Requirements? Just show up!" That's the pitch for the **DIMFF 2027 mobile film festival**, an open door festival brought to you by [@dimff.ulab](https://www.instagram.com/dimff.ulab/) and [@officialulab](https://www.instagram.com/officialulab/). If you have a phone and a story, this is one of the most accessible film calls we've seen.

## DIMFF 2027 mobile film festival categories

"5 Categories. 1 Global Stage. Endless Stories." Here's the line-up:

- **Open Door:** mobile or camera
- **Vertical Film:** mobile or camera, vertical format
- **Short Film:** mobile or camera
- **One Minute Film:** mobile only
- **Citizen Journalism:** mobile only

Three categories accept work shot on either a mobile or a camera, while One Minute Film and Citizen Journalism are mobile only. Vertical Film is the one to watch if you already shoot in the vertical format your phone defaults to for social video.

## Who can submit

The call is open to students and to filmmakers "from anywhere in the world". The aim is to tell your story "using the power of mobile filmmaking", or as the post sums it up: "Lights. Camera. Mobile. Let your story be seen."

## Deadline and how to submit to the mobile film festival

- **Deadline:** 24 September 2026
- **Submit via:** [DIMFF on FilmFreeway](https://filmfreeway.com/DIMFF)
- **Website:** [dimff.net](https://dimff.net/)

You can also follow the festival on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/dimff-ulab) and [YouTube](https://youtube.com/c/DhakaInternationalMobileFilmFestival), where the channel name spells DIMFF out as the Dhaka International Mobile Film Festival.

The cover sets the tone: the DIMFF letters filled with bright floral patterns, an illustrated face peeking over them, "Mobile Film" in large type below, and the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh crest in the corner.

## More film on our radar

Mobile filmmaking lowers the barrier to entry, which is exactly why open calls like this matter. For a deeper look at moving image history, read about the British Council talk [Introverted Film and Erratic Infrastructure](post:introverted-film-erratic-infrastructure-british-council-dhaka). Musicians chasing a global audience should also see the [Hong Kong radio show opportunity for Bangladeshi DJs and producers](post:hong-kong-radio-show-bangladeshi-djs-producers), and our [September events list](post:dhaka-events-to-save-september-2026) has more dates to save. Browse [Film & Talks](topic:film) or head to the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

Open Door (mobile/camera), Vertical Film (mobile/camera, vertical format), Short Film (mobile/camera), One Minute Film (mobile only) and Citizen Journalism (mobile only).
